# Cost of one foundation (spread or improved)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def round3(x): return max(math.floor(x/3.0+1e-9)*3.0, 3.0) if False else math.ceil(x/3.0-1e-9)*3.0
def cost_footing(pad, tag, B_in, L_in, t_in, rho, improved, pier_count=0, pier_depth_ft=0):
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0; Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    fc=FC[pad][0]
    vol_conc=B*L*t  # ft3
    cy=vol_conc/27.0
    steel_lb=2*rho*vol_conc*GAMMA_STEEL
    # excavation: (B+2)x(L+2)xDf, no side slopes (<4ft)
    exc=(B+2.0)*(L+2.0)*Df/27.0
    backfill=max(exc-cy,0.0)
    c=PRICE_CONC[fc]*cy+PRICE_STEEL*steel_lb+PRICE_EXC*exc+PRICE_BACKFILL*backfill
    if improved:
        pier_lf=pier_count*pier_depth_ft
        c+=PRICE_PIER_LF*pier_lf
        platform_sy=B*L*9.0  # sq ft to sq yd
        c+=PRICE_PLATFORM*platform_sy

def settlement_in(pad, B, L, sta, q_net_ksf, start_z=0.0, dz=0.25):
    """Settlement (in) from layered elastic compression. q_net in ksf (net pressure).
    Integrates from start_z to depth = max(4B,40) below bearing surface."""
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    depth = max(4.0*B, 40.0)
    if start_z>=depth: return 0.0
    s=0.0
    z=start_z+dz/2.0
    while z < depth:
        # 2V:1H stress spread
        dsig = q_net_ksf*(B*L)/((B+z)*(L+z))
        dbg = Df+z
        es = es_at(pad, sta, dbg)  # ksf
        s += dsig*dz/es  # ft
        z += dz
    return s*12.0  # to inches

    return GAMMA_CONC*B*L*t_ft/1000.0  # kips

def shear_thickness_in(pad, tag, B_in, L_in):
    """Required thickness (in) from one-way and two-way (punching) shear.
    Returns required d (in) then t=d+4 (rounded). Uses phi=0.75 (EM 1110-2-2104)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0
    fc = FC[pad][0]
    phishear=0.75
    sqf=math.sqrt(fc)  # psi
    # factored net bearing pressure (ksf) -> psi
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]
    # net factored pressure ~ Pf/(B*L) + 1.2*(gamma_conc-gamma_soil)*t  (small, ignore t term)
    qf = Pf/(B*L)  # ksf  (gross factored, conservative for shear)
    qf_psf=qf*1000.0
    # iterate d
    d=12.0
    for _ in range(60):
        dft=d/12.0
        if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
            c=FCOL[tag]/12.0  # column side ft
            # one-way shear: critical at d from face. Vu = qf*B*(B/2 - c/2 - dft) on one side
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*B*max(a1,0.0)  # lb (per the strip)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*B*12.0*d  # phi later; b in inches = B*12
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way punching: bo=4*(c+dft), Vu=qf*(B*B - (c+dft)^2) for square footing B=B=L? use B,L
            bo=4*(c+dft)
            area_punch=max((c+dft)**2,0.0)
            Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*B - area_punch,0.0)  # assumes square B=L; for rect use B*L
            if B!=L:
                area_punch=(c+dft)**2  # square column
                Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*L-area_punch,0.0)
            Vc2=4*sqf*bo*12.0*d
            d_req2=Vu2/(phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0) if (phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0)>0 else 0
        else:
            # wall footing: one-way shear across width B (wall c=1ft=12in, length L)
            c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*L*max(a1,0.0)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*L*12.0*d
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way: wall is long -> punching only at wall ends; check one-way governs. d_req2=0
            d_req2=0.0
        d_new=max(d_req1,d_req2,8.0)
        if abs(d_new-d)<0.01: 
            d=d_new; break
        d=d_new
    t=d+4.0
    # round up to nearest 3 in
    t3=math.ceil(t/3.0)*3.0
    return max(t3,12.0), d

def flex_steel_ratio(pad, tag, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    """Required gross reinforcement ratio (As/(b*t)) from flexure (each direction)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0

    fc=FC[pad][0]; fy=60000.0
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]; c=FCOL[tag]/12.0
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]; c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
    qf=Pf/(B*L)*1000.0  # psf factored
    # moment per unit width (1 ft) at face: m=qf*(B/2-c/2)^2/2  (lb-ft/ft)
    m1=qf*(B/2-c/2)**2/2.0  # lb-ft per ft width
    # As per ft: As=m/(phi fy (d-a/2)), phi=0.9, a=As fy/(0.85 fc 12)

    # iterate
    As=0.001
    for _ in range(50):
        a=As*fy/(0.85*fc*12.0)
        m_cap=phi*As*fy*(d-a/2.0)*12.0  # lb-ft per ft
        if m_cap>=m1: break

    rho_gross = As/(12.0*t_in)

def wall_stability(pad, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0; Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    gsoil=STRATA["I"]["gamma"]; phi=STRATA["I"]["phi"]
    w=LOADS[pad]["W1"]
    P_dlpw,H_dlpw,M_dlpw = w[5],w[6],w[7]  # service D+L+W
    P_06d,H_06d,M_06d = w[2],w[3],w[4]     # 0.6D+W
    P_dead=w[8]; uplift=abs(w[9])
    # self weight & soil above projection
    Wf=GAMMA_CONC*B*L*t  # lb
    proj=(B - WALL_T_IN/12.0)  # ft beyond wall
    soil_depth=max(Df-t,0.0)
    Wsoil=gsoil*proj*soil_depth*L  # lb
    # eccentricity (direction of wall shear = along column line = B direction for end wall)
    e = M_dlpw/P_dlpw  # ft  (service D+L+W)
    e_in=e*12.0
    # sliding: friction on 0.6D + 0.5 passive
    V_06d=P_06d*1000.0  # lb
    tanfi=math.tan(math.radians(2.0/3.0*phi))
    fr=V_06d*tanfi
    kp=math.tan(math.radians(45+phi/2.0))**2
    Pp=0.5*gsoil*Df**2*kp*L  # lb (passive on L x Df face, sliding along column line)
    sliding_res=fr+0.5*Pp
    sliding_fs=sliding_res/(H_06d*1000.0) if H_06d>0 else 99
    # uplift
    uplift_res=0.6*(Wf+Wsoil+P_dead*1000.0)
    uplift_fs=uplift_res/(uplift*1000.0) if uplift>0 else 99
    return dict(eccentricity_in=e_in, B6_in=B_in/6.0, sliding_fs=sliding_fs, uplift_fs=uplift_fs)

def base_I_at(pad, sta):
    """Interpolated base of Stratum I (ft below grade) at a station."""
    a = BASE_I_A[pad]; b = BASE_I_B[pad]
    return a + (b-a)*(sta/77.0)

def es_at(pad, sta, depth_below_grade_ft):
    bi = base_I_at(pad, sta)
    ii_top = bi
    ii_bot = bi + II_THK[pad]
    if depth_below_grade_ft < bi:
        return ES_I[pad]
    elif depth_below_grade_ft < ii_bot:
        return ES_II[pad]
    else:
        return ES_III[pad]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bearing capacity (Terzaghi, Meyerhof, Brinch Hansen) - drained, effective stress
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def bearing_factors(phi_deg):
    phi = math.radians(phi_deg)
    kp = math.tan(math.pi/4+phi/2)**2
    nq = kp*math.exp(math.pi*math.tan(phi))
    nc = (nq-1)/math.tan(phi) if phi_deg>0 else 5.14
    # N gamma
    ng_mey = (nq-1)*math.tan(1.4*phi)
    # Terzaghi N gamma (Coduto approx used in DM7.2 table): use tabulated
    return nc,nq,kp,ng_mey

# tabulated N factors (DM7.2 Table 5-2) at 2-deg increments; interpolate
TAB = {
26:(27,22,22, 14,12,12, 11,8.0,7.9),
33:(48,39,39, 32,26,26, 33,26,24),
38:(78,61,61, 62,49,49, 82,64,56),
}
def nfact(phi_deg):
    # returns dict with Terzaghi/Meyerhof/Hansen Nc,Nq,Ng
    # interpolate from table at 2-deg
    keys=sorted(TAB.keys())
    lo=max(k for k in keys if k<=phi_deg); hi=min(k for k in keys if k>=phi_deg)
    if lo==hi:
        t=TAB[lo]
    else:
        f=(phi_deg-lo)/(hi-lo)
        t=tuple(a+(b-a)*f for a,b in zip(TAB[lo],TAB[hi]))
    return dict(Nc=(t[0],t[1],t[2]),Nq=(t[3],t[4],t[5]),Ng=(t[6],t[7],t[8]))

def ult_bearing(pad, B, L, sta, method):
    """Gross ultimate bearing capacity (ksf) for rectangular footing B x L (ft),
    bearing in Stratum I at depth Df, groundwater correction applied.
    method: 'T','M','H' (Terzaghi, Meyerhof, Hansen)."""
    Df = BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    s = STRATA["I"]; phi=s["phi"]; c=s["c"]; gamma=s["gamma"]
    nf = nfact(phi)
    idx={'T':0,'M':1,'H':2}[method]
    Nc=nf['Nc'][idx]; Nq=nf['Nq'][idx]; Ng=nf['Ng'][idx]
    # groundwater: water table depth below base
    dw = GW[pad]-Df
    gamma_eff = gamma
    if dw < B:
        gamma_sub = gamma-GAMMA_W
        gamma_eff = gamma_sub + min(1.0,dw/max(B,1e-9))*(gamma-gamma_sub)
    sigma_D = gamma*Df/1000.0  # surcharge at base (moist, water table below footing) -> ksf
    gamma_k = gamma_eff/1000.0
    c_k = c
    # shape & depth factors
    if method=='T':
        # Terzaghi: shape by table (square/continuous). Use rectangular interp by B/L
        # square: sc=1.3,sq=1,sg=0.8 ; continuous:1,1,1
        r = min(B/L,1.0)
        sc=1+0.3*r; sq=1.0; sg=0.8+0.2*(1-r)
        # depth: Terzaghi ignores depth (set 1)
        dc=dq=dg=1.0
    elif method=='M':
        kp=math.tan(math.pi/4+math.radians(phi)/2)**2
        r=B/L
        sc=1+0.2*r*kp; sq=1+0.1*r*kp; sg=1+0.1*r*kp
        k=Df/B
        dc=1+0.2*k*math.sqrt(kp); dq=1+0.1*k*math.sqrt(kp); dg=1+0.1*k*math.sqrt(kp)
    else: # Hansen
        kp=math.tan(math.pi/4+math.radians(phi)/2)**2
        r=B/L
        sc=1+0.2*r; sq=1+0.1*r; sg=1-0.2*r  # approx Hansen shape
        k=Df/B
        dc=1+0.4*k; dq=1+2*math.tan(phi*math.pi/180)*(1-math.sin(phi*math.pi/180))**2*k; dg=1.0
    q_ult = c_k*Nc*sc*dc + sigma_D*Nq*sq*dq + 0.5*gamma_k*B*Ng*sg*dg
    return q_ult

def q_allow_net(pad, B, L, sta, method='M'):
    q_ult = ult_bearing(pad,B,L,sta,method)
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    sigma_D = STRATA["I"]["gamma"]*Df/1000.0
    return q_ult/FS[pad] - sigma_D   # gross-based net allowable (conservative)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Settlement - layered elastic, 2V:1H, 0.25 ft layers, depth = max(4B,40)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def settlement_in(pad, B, L, sta, q_net_ksf, start_z=0.0, dz=0.25):
    """Settlement (in) from layered elastic compression. q_net in ksf (net pressure).
    Integrates from start_z to depth = max(4B,40) below bearing surface."""
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    depth = max(4.0*B, 40.0)
    if start_z>=depth: return 0.0
    s=0.0
    z=start_z+dz/2.0
    while z < depth:
        # 2V:1H stress spread
        dsig = q_net_ksf*(B*L)/((B+z)*(L+z))
        dbg = Df+z
        es = es_at(pad, sta, dbg)  # ksf
        s += dsig*dz/es  # ft
        z += dz
    return s*12.0  # to inches

def footing_self_weight_kips(B,L,t_ft):
    return GAMMA_CONC*B*L*t_ft/1000.0  # kips

def q_net_applied(pad, tag, B, L, t_ft):
    P = LOADS[pad][tag][0] if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5") else LOADS[pad]["W1"][0]
    Wf = footing_self_weight_kips(B,L,t_ft)
    gross = (P+Wf)/(B*L)
    overburden = STRATA["I"]["gamma"]*BEARING_DEPTH_FT/1000.0
    return gross-overburden  # ksf

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Footing thickness from shear (one-way & two-way), flexural steel
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def shear_thickness_in(pad, tag, B_in, L_in):
    """Required thickness (in) from one-way and two-way (punching) shear.
    Returns required d (in) then t=d+4 (rounded). Uses phi=0.75 (EM 1110-2-2104)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0
    fc = FC[pad][0]
    phishear=0.75
    sqf=math.sqrt(fc)  # psi
    # factored net bearing pressure (ksf) -> psi
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]
    # net factored pressure ~ Pf/(B*L) + 1.2*(gamma_conc-gamma_soil)*t  (small, ignore t term)
    qf = Pf/(B*L)  # ksf  (gross factored, conservative for shear)
    qf_psf=qf*1000.0
    # iterate d
    d=12.0
    for _ in range(60):
        dft=d/12.0
        if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
            c=FCOL[tag]/12.0  # column side ft
            # one-way shear: critical at d from face. Vu = qf*B*(B/2 - c/2 - dft) on one side
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*B*max(a1,0.0)  # lb (per the strip)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*B*12.0*d  # phi later; b in inches = B*12
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way punching: bo=4*(c+dft), Vu=qf*(B*B - (c+dft)^2) for square footing B=B=L? use B,L
            bo=4*(c+dft)
            area_punch=max((c+dft)**2,0.0)
            Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*B - area_punch,0.0)  # assumes square B=L; for rect use B*L
            if B!=L:
                area_punch=(c+dft)**2  # square column
                Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*L-area_punch,0.0)
            Vc2=4*sqf*bo*12.0*d
            d_req2=Vu2/(phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0) if (phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0)>0 else 0
        else:
            # wall footing: one-way shear across width B (wall c=1ft=12in, length L)
            c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*L*max(a1,0.0)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*L*12.0*d
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way: wall is long -> punching only at wall ends; check one-way governs. d_req2=0
            d_req2=0.0
        d_new=max(d_req1,d_req2,8.0)
        if abs(d_new-d)<0.01: 
            d=d_new; break
        d=d_new
    t=d+4.0
    # round up to nearest 3 in
    t3=math.ceil(t/3.0)*3.0
    return max(t3,12.0), d

def flex_steel_ratio(pad, tag, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    """Required gross reinforcement ratio (As/(b*t)) from flexure (each direction)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0
    d=(t_in-4.0)/12.0  # ft
    fc=FC[pad][0]; fy=60000.0
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]; c=FCOL[tag]/12.0
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]; c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
    qf=Pf/(B*L)*1000.0  # psf factored
    # moment per unit width (1 ft) at face: m=qf*(B/2-c/2)^2/2  (lb-ft/ft)
    m1=qf*(B/2-c/2)**2/2.0  # lb-ft per ft width
    # As per ft: As=m/(phi fy (d-a/2)), phi=0.9, a=As fy/(0.85 fc 12)
    phi=0.90
    As=0.0
    # solve As: m=phi As fy (d - As fy/(1.7 fc 12))
    # iterate
    As=0.001
    for _ in range(50):
        a=As*fy/(0.85*fc*12.0)
        m_cap=phi*As*fy*(d-a/2.0)*12.0  # lb-ft per ft
        if m_cap>=m1: break
        As*=1.05
    # gross ratio = As (in2/ft) / (12in * t_in)  = As/(b*t)
    rho_gross = As/(12.0*t_in)
    # min ratio
    if t_in>36.0:
        rho_min=0.0015
    else:
        rho_min=0.0018
    return max(rho_gross,rho_min), rho_min

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stability checks for W1 (sliding, overturning middle-third, uplift)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def wall_stability(pad, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0; Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    gsoil=STRATA["I"]["gamma"]; phi=STRATA["I"]["phi"]
    w=LOADS[pad]["W1"]
    P_dlpw,H_dlpw,M_dlpw = w[5],w[6],w[7]  # service D+L+W
    P_06d,H_06d,M_06d = w[2],w[3],w[4]     # 0.6D+W
    P_dead=w[8]; uplift=abs(w[9])
    # self weight & soil above projection
    Wf=GAMMA_CONC*B*L*t  # lb
    proj=(B - WALL_T_IN/12.0)  # ft beyond wall
    soil_depth=max(Df-t,0.0)
    Wsoil=gsoil*proj*soil_depth*L  # lb
    # eccentricity (direction of wall shear = along column line = B direction for end wall)
    e = M_dlpw/P_dlpw  # ft  (service D+L+W)
    e_in=e*12.0
    # sliding: friction on 0.6D + 0.5 passive
    V_06d=P_06d*1000.0  # lb
    tanfi=math.tan(math.radians(2.0/3.0*phi))
    fr=V_06d*tanfi
    kp=math.tan(math.radians(45+phi/2.0))**2
    Pp=0.5*gsoil*Df**2*kp*L  # lb (passive on L x Df face, sliding along column line)
    sliding_res=fr+0.5*Pp
    sliding_fs=sliding_res/(H_06d*1000.0) if H_06d>0 else 99
    # uplift
    uplift_res=0.6*(Wf+Wsoil+P_dead*1000.0)
    uplift_fs=uplift_res/(uplift*1000.0) if uplift>0 else 99
    return dict(eccentricity_in=e_in, B6_in=B_in/6.0, sliding_fs=sliding_fs, uplift_fs=uplift_fs)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cost of one foundation (spread or improved)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def round3(x): return max(math.floor(x/3.0+1e-9)*3.0, 3.0) if False else math.ceil(x/3.0-1e-9)*3.0
def cost_footing(pad, tag, B_in, L_in, t_in, rho, improved, pier_count=0, pier_depth_ft=0):
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0; Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    fc=FC[pad][0]
    vol_conc=B*L*t  # ft3
    cy=vol_conc/27.0
    steel_lb=2*rho*vol_conc*GAMMA_STEEL
    # excavation: (B+2)x(L+2)xDf, no side slopes (<4ft)
    exc=(B+2.0)*(L+2.0)*Df/27.0
    backfill=max(exc-cy,0.0)
    c=PRICE_CONC[fc]*cy+PRICE_STEEL*steel_lb+PRICE_EXC*exc+PRICE_BACKFILL*backfill
    if improved:
        pier_lf=pier_count*pier_depth_ft
        c+=PRICE_PIER_LF*pier_lf
        platform_sy=B*L*9.0  # sq ft to sq yd
        c+=PRICE_PLATFORM*platform_sy
    return c

def size_spread_one(pad, tag, target_settle=SETTLE_LIMIT_IN):
    """Find smallest footing (3in grid) for spread, meeting settlement<=target and bearing.
    Computes shear thickness first, then net pressure (incl footing+backfill) and settlement."""
    sta=FSTA[tag]
    min_w = 24 if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5") else 20

def bearing_factors(phi_deg):
    phi = math.radians(phi_deg)
    kp = math.tan(math.pi/4+phi/2)**2
    nq = kp*math.exp(math.pi*math.tan(phi))
    nc = (nq-1)/math.tan(phi) if phi_deg>0 else 5.14
    # N gamma
    ng_mey = (nq-1)*math.tan(1.4*phi)
    # Terzaghi N gamma (Coduto approx used in DM7.2 table): use tabulated
    return nc,nq,kp,ng_mey

    # interpolate from table at 2-deg
    keys=sorted(TAB.keys())
    lo=max(k for k in keys if k<=phi_deg); hi=min(k for k in keys if k>=phi_deg)

    Integrates from start_z to depth = max(4B,40) below bearing surface."""
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    depth = max(4.0*B, 40.0)

    z=start_z+dz/2.0

def shear_thickness_in(pad, tag, B_in, L_in):
    """Required thickness (in) from one-way and two-way (punching) shear.
    Returns required d (in) then t=d+4 (rounded). Uses phi=0.75 (EM 1110-2-2104)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0
    fc = FC[pad][0]
    phishear=0.75
    sqf=math.sqrt(fc)  # psi
    # factored net bearing pressure (ksf) -> psi
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]
    # net factored pressure ~ Pf/(B*L) + 1.2*(gamma_conc-gamma_soil)*t  (small, ignore t term)
    qf = Pf/(B*L)  # ksf  (gross factored, conservative for shear)
    qf_psf=qf*1000.0
    # iterate d
    d=12.0
    for _ in range(60):
        dft=d/12.0
        if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
            c=FCOL[tag]/12.0  # column side ft
            # one-way shear: critical at d from face. Vu = qf*B*(B/2 - c/2 - dft) on one side
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*B*max(a1,0.0)  # lb (per the strip)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*B*12.0*d  # phi later; b in inches = B*12
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way punching: bo=4*(c+dft), Vu=qf*(B*B - (c+dft)^2) for square footing B=B=L? use B,L
            bo=4*(c+dft)
            area_punch=max((c+dft)**2,0.0)
            Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*B - area_punch,0.0)  # assumes square B=L; for rect use B*L
            if B!=L:
                area_punch=(c+dft)**2  # square column
                Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*L-area_punch,0.0)
            Vc2=4*sqf*bo*12.0*d
            d_req2=Vu2/(phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0) if (phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0)>0 else 0
        else:
            # wall footing: one-way shear across width B (wall c=1ft=12in, length L)
            c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*L*max(a1,0.0)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*L*12.0*d
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way: wall is long -> punching only at wall ends; check one-way governs. d_req2=0
            d_req2=0.0
        d_new=max(d_req1,d_req2,8.0)
        if abs(d_new-d)<0.01: 
            d=d_new; break
        d=d_new
    t=d+4.0
    # round up to nearest 3 in
    t3=math.ceil(t/3.0)*3.0
    return max(t3,12.0), d

def flex_steel_ratio(pad, tag, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    """Required gross reinforcement ratio (As/(b*t)) from flexure (each direction)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0
    d=(t_in-4.0)/12.0  # ft
    fc=FC[pad][0]; fy=60000.0
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]; c=FCOL[tag]/12.0
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]; c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
    qf=Pf/(B*L)*1000.0  # psf factored
    # moment per unit width (1 ft) at face: m=qf*(B/2-c/2)^2/2  (lb-ft/ft)
    m1=qf*(B/2-c/2)**2/2.0  # lb-ft per ft width
    # As per ft: As=m/(phi fy (d-a/2)), phi=0.9, a=As fy/(0.85 fc 12)
    phi=0.90
    As=0.0
    # solve As: m=phi As fy (d - As fy/(1.7 fc 12))
    # iterate
    As=0.001
    for _ in range(50):
        a=As*fy/(0.85*fc*12.0)
        m_cap=phi*As*fy*(d-a/2.0)*12.0  # lb-ft per ft
        if m_cap>=m1: break
        As*=1.05
    # gross ratio = As (in2/ft) / (12in * t_in)  = As/(b*t)
    rho_gross = As/(12.0*t_in)
    # min ratio
    if t_in>36.0:
        rho_min=0.0015
    else:
        rho_min=0.0018
    return max(rho_gross,rho_min), rho_min

# Stability checks for W1 (sliding, overturning middle-third, uplift)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def wall_stability(pad, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0; Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    gsoil=STRATA["I"]["gamma"]; phi=STRATA["I"]["phi"]
    w=LOADS[pad]["W1"]
    P_dlpw,H_dlpw,M_dlpw = w[5],w[6],w[7]  # service D+L+W
    P_06d,H_06d,M_06d = w[2],w[3],w[4]     # 0.6D+W
    P_dead=w[8]; uplift=abs(w[9])
    # self weight & soil above projection
    Wf=GAMMA_CONC*B*L*t  # lb
    proj=(B - WALL_T_IN/12.0)  # ft beyond wall
    soil_depth=max(Df-t,0.0)
    Wsoil=gsoil*proj*soil_depth*L  # lb
    # eccentricity (direction of wall shear = along column line = B direction for end wall)
    e = M_dlpw/P_dlpw  # ft  (service D+L+W)
    e_in=e*12.0
    # sliding: friction on 0.6D + 0.5 passive
    V_06d=P_06d*1000.0  # lb
    tanfi=math.tan(math.radians(2.0/3.0*phi))
    fr=V_06d*tanfi
    kp=math.tan(math.radians(45+phi/2.0))**2
    Pp=0.5*gsoil*Df**2*kp*L  # lb (passive on L x Df face, sliding along column line)
    sliding_res=fr+0.5*Pp
    sliding_fs=sliding_res/(H_06d*1000.0) if H_06d>0 else 99
    # uplift
    uplift_res=0.6*(Wf+Wsoil+P_dead*1000.0)
    uplift_fs=uplift_res/(uplift*1000.0) if uplift>0 else 99
    return dict(eccentricity_in=e_in, B6_in=B_in/6.0, sliding_fs=sliding_fs, uplift_fs=uplift_fs)

def cost_footing(pad, tag, B_in, L_in, t_in, rho, improved, pier_count=0, pier_depth_ft=0):
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0; Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT

    exc=(B+2.0)*(L+2.0)*Df/27.0

    """Required gross reinforcement ratio (As/(b*t)) from flexure (each direction)."""

        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]; c=FCOL[tag]/12.0
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]; c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
    qf=Pf/(B*L)*1000.0  # psf factored
    # moment per unit width (1 ft) at face: m=qf*(B/2-c/2)^2/2  (lb-ft/ft)
    m1=qf*(B/2-c/2)**2/2.0  # lb-ft per ft width
    # As per ft: As=m/(phi fy (d-a/2)), phi=0.9, a=As fy/(0.85 fc 12)
    phi=0.90
    As=0.0
    # solve As: m=phi As fy (d - As fy/(1.7 fc 12))
    # iterate
    As=0.001
    for _ in range(50):
        a=As*fy/(0.85*fc*12.0)
        m_cap=phi*As*fy*(d-a/2.0)*12.0  # lb-ft per ft

    gsoil=STRATA["I"]["gamma"]; phi=STRATA["I"]["phi"]
    w=LOADS[pad]["W1"]
    P_dlpw,H_dlpw,M_dlpw = w[5],w[6],w[7]  # service D+L+W
    P_06d,H_06d,M_06d = w[2],w[3],w[4]     # 0.6D+W
    P_dead=w[8]; uplift=abs(w[9])
    # self weight & soil above projection
    Wf=GAMMA_CONC*B*L*t  # lb
    proj=(B - WALL_T_IN/12.0)  # ft beyond wall
    soil_depth=max(Df-t,0.0)
    Wsoil=gsoil*proj*soil_depth*L  # lb
    # eccentricity (direction of wall shear = along column line = B direction for end wall)
    e = M_dlpw/P_dlpw  # ft  (service D+L+W)
    e_in=e*12.0
    # sliding: friction on 0.6D + 0.5 passive
    V_06d=P_06d*1000.0  # lb
    tanfi=math.tan(math.radians(2.0/3.0*phi))
    fr=V_06d*tanfi
    kp=math.tan(math.radians(45+phi/2.0))**2
    Pp=0.5*gsoil*Df**2*kp*L  # lb (passive on L x Df face, sliding along column line)
    sliding_res=fr+0.5*Pp
    sliding_fs=sliding_res/(H_06d*1000.0) if H_06d>0 else 99

    uplift_res=0.6*(Wf+Wsoil+P_dead*1000.0)
    uplift_fs=uplift_res/(uplift*1000.0) if uplift>0 else 99
    return dict(eccentricity_in=e_in, B6_in=B_in/6.0, sliding_fs=sliding_fs, uplift_fs=uplift_fs)

   "W1":(1683.0,2288.9,722.2,97.9,897.6,1683.0,97.9,897.6,1203.6,-265.2)},
}
# W1 tuple: (P_service, P_factored, P_0.6D, H_0.6DW, M_0.6DW, P_DLPW, H_DLPW, M_DLPW, P_dead, uplift)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Geometry helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def base_I_at(pad, sta):
    """Interpolated base of Stratum I (ft below grade) at a station."""
    a = BASE_I_A[pad]; b = BASE_I_B[pad]
    return a + (b-a)*(sta/77.0)

def es_at(pad, sta, depth_below_grade_ft):
    bi = base_I_at(pad, sta)
    ii_top = bi
    ii_bot = bi + II_THK[pad]
    if depth_below_grade_ft < bi:
        return ES_I[pad]
    elif depth_below_grade_ft < ii_bot:
        return ES_II[pad]
    else:
        return ES_III[pad]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bearing capacity (Terzaghi, Meyerhof, Brinch Hansen) - drained, effective stress
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def bearing_factors(phi_deg):
    phi = math.radians(phi_deg)
    kp = math.tan(math.pi/4+phi/2)**2
    nq = kp*math.exp(math.pi*math.tan(phi))
    nc = (nq-1)/math.tan(phi) if phi_deg>0 else 5.14
    # N gamma
    ng_mey = (nq-1)*math.tan(1.4*phi)
    # Terzaghi N gamma (Coduto approx used in DM7.2 table): use tabulated
    return nc,nq,kp,ng_mey

# tabulated N factors (DM7.2 Table 5-2) at 2-deg increments; interpolate
TAB = {
26:(27,22,22, 14,12,12, 11,8.0,7.9),
33:(48,39,39, 32,26,26, 33,26,24),
38:(78,61,61, 62,49,49, 82,64,56),
}
def nfact(phi_deg):
    # returns dict with Terzaghi/Meyerhof/Hansen Nc,Nq,Ng
    # interpolate from table at 2-deg
    keys=sorted(TAB.keys())
    lo=max(k for k in keys if k<=phi_deg); hi=min(k for k in keys if k>=phi_deg)
    if lo==hi:
        t=TAB[lo]
    else:
        f=(phi_deg-lo)/(hi-lo)
        t=tuple(a+(b-a)*f for a,b in zip(TAB[lo],TAB[hi]))
    return dict(Nc=(t[0],t[1],t[2]),Nq=(t[3],t[4],t[5]),Ng=(t[6],t[7],t[8]))

def ult_bearing(pad, B, L, sta, method):
    """Gross ultimate bearing capacity (ksf) for rectangular footing B x L (ft),
    bearing in Stratum I at depth Df, groundwater correction applied.
    method: 'T','M','H' (Terzaghi, Meyerhof, Hansen)."""
    Df = BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    s = STRATA["I"]; phi=s["phi"]; c=s["c"]; gamma=s["gamma"]
    nf = nfact(phi)
    idx={'T':0,'M':1,'H':2}[method]
    Nc=nf['Nc'][idx]; Nq=nf['Nq'][idx]; Ng=nf['Ng'][idx]
    # groundwater: water table depth below base
    dw = GW[pad]-Df
    gamma_eff = gamma
    if dw < B:
        gamma_sub = gamma-GAMMA_W
        gamma_eff = gamma_sub + min(1.0,dw/max(B,1e-9))*(gamma-gamma_sub)
    sigma_D = gamma*Df/1000.0  # surcharge at base (moist, water table below footing) -> ksf
    gamma_k = gamma_eff/1000.0
    c_k = c
    # shape & depth factors
    if method=='T':
        # Terzaghi: shape by table (square/continuous). Use rectangular interp by B/L
        # square: sc=1.3,sq=1,sg=0.8 ; continuous:1,1,1
        r = min(B/L,1.0)
        sc=1+0.3*r; sq=1.0; sg=0.8+0.2*(1-r)
        # depth: Terzaghi ignores depth (set 1)
        dc=dq=dg=1.0
    elif method=='M':
        kp=math.tan(math.pi/4+math.radians(phi)/2)**2
        r=B/L
        sc=1+0.2*r*kp; sq=1+0.1*r*kp; sg=1+0.1*r*kp
        k=Df/B
        dc=1+0.2*k*math.sqrt(kp); dq=1+0.1*k*math.sqrt(kp); dg=1+0.1*k*math.sqrt(kp)
    else: # Hansen
        kp=math.tan(math.pi/4+math.radians(phi)/2)**2
        r=B/L
        sc=1+0.2*r; sq=1+0.1*r; sg=1-0.2*r  # approx Hansen shape
        k=Df/B
        dc=1+0.4*k; dq=1+2*math.tan(phi*math.pi/180)*(1-math.sin(phi*math.pi/180))**2*k; dg=1.0
    q_ult = c_k*Nc*sc*dc + sigma_D*Nq*sq*dq + 0.5*gamma_k*B*Ng*sg*dg
    return q_ult

def q_allow_net(pad, B, L, sta, method='M'):
    q_ult = ult_bearing(pad,B,L,sta,method)
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    sigma_D = STRATA["I"]["gamma"]*Df/1000.0
    return q_ult/FS[pad] - sigma_D   # gross-based net allowable (conservative)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Settlement - layered elastic, 2V:1H, 0.25 ft layers, depth = max(4B,40)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def settlement_in(pad, B, L, sta, q_net_ksf, start_z=0.0, dz=0.25):
    """Settlement (in) from layered elastic compression. q_net in ksf (net pressure).
    Integrates from start_z to depth = max(4B,40) below bearing surface."""
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    depth = max(4.0*B, 40.0)
    if start_z>=depth: return 0.0
    s=0.0
    z=start_z+dz/2.0
    while z < depth:
        # 2V:1H stress spread
        dsig = q_net_ksf*(B*L)/((B+z)*(L+z))
        dbg = Df+z
        es = es_at(pad, sta, dbg)  # ksf
        s += dsig*dz/es  # ft
        z += dz
    return s*12.0  # to inches

def footing_self_weight_kips(B,L,t_ft):
    return GAMMA_CONC*B*L*t_ft/1000.0  # kips

def service_P(pad,tag):
    return LOADS[pad][tag][0] if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5") else LOADS[pad]["W1"][0]
def factored_P(pad,tag):
    return LOADS[pad][tag][1] if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5") else LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]

def q_gross_ksf(pad, tag, B, L, t_ft):
    # gross applied bearing pressure incl footing self weight + backfill (ksf)
    P = service_P(pad,tag)
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    gsoil=STRATA["I"]["gamma"]
    return (P*1000.0 + GAMMA_CONC*t_ft*1000.0 + gsoil*(Df-t_ft)*1000.0)/(B*L*1000.0)

def q_net_applied(pad, tag, B, L, t_ft):
    # physical net = gross - overburden (incl backfill which cancels)
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    return q_gross_ksf(pad,tag,B,L,t_ft) - STRATA["I"]["gamma"]*Df/1000.0  # ksf

if __name__=="__main__":
    for pad in PADS:
        print(pad, "FS",FS[pad],"sulf",SULF[pad],S_CLASS[pad],"fc",FC[pad][0],"wcm",FC[pad][1],"classes",FC[pad][2])
        for tag in ["F1","F2","F3","F4","F5","W1"]:
            sta=FSTA[tag]
            bi=base_I_at(pad,sta)
            print(f"  {tag} sta={sta} baseI={bi:.2f} StratumI_below={bi-BEARING_DEPTH_FT:.2f}ft")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Footing thickness from shear (one-way & two-way), flexural steel
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def shear_thickness_in(pad, tag, B_in, L_in):
    """Required thickness (in) from one-way and two-way (punching) shear.
    Returns required d (in) then t=d+4 (rounded). Uses phi=0.75 (EM 1110-2-2104)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0
    fc = FC[pad][0]
    phishear=0.75
    sqf=math.sqrt(fc)  # psi
    # factored net bearing pressure (ksf) -> psi
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]
    # net factored pressure ~ Pf/(B*L) + 1.2*(gamma_conc-gamma_soil)*t  (small, ignore t term)
    qf = Pf/(B*L)  # ksf  (gross factored, conservative for shear)
    qf_psf=qf*1000.0
    # iterate d
    d=12.0
    for _ in range(60):
        dft=d/12.0
        if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
            c=FCOL[tag]/12.0  # column side ft
            # one-way shear: critical at d from face. Vu = qf*B*(B/2 - c/2 - dft) on one side
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*B*max(a1,0.0)  # lb (per the strip)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*B*12.0*d  # phi later; b in inches = B*12
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way punching: bo=4*(c+dft), Vu=qf*(B*B - (c+dft)^2) for square footing B=B=L? use B,L
            bo=4*(c+dft)
            area_punch=max((c+dft)**2,0.0)
            Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*B - area_punch,0.0)  # assumes square B=L; for rect use B*L
            if B!=L:
                area_punch=(c+dft)**2  # square column
                Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*L-area_punch,0.0)
            Vc2=4*sqf*bo*12.0*d
            d_req2=Vu2/(phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0) if (phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0)>0 else 0
        else:
            # wall footing: one-way shear across width B (wall c=1ft=12in, length L)
            c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*L*max(a1,0.0)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*L*12.0*d
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way: wall is long -> punching only at wall ends; check one-way governs. d_req2=0
            d_req2=0.0
        d_new=max(d_req1,d_req2,8.0)
        if abs(d_new-d)<0.01: 
            d=d_new; break
        d=d_new
    t=d+4.0
    # round up to nearest 3 in
    t3=math.ceil(t/3.0)*3.0
    return max(t3,12.0), d

def flex_steel_ratio(pad, tag, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    """Required gross reinforcement ratio (As/(b*t)) from flexure (each direction)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0
    d=(t_in-4.0)/12.0  # ft
    fc=FC[pad][0]; fy=60000.0
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]; c=FCOL[tag]/12.0
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]; c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
    qf=Pf/(B*L)*1000.0  # psf factored
    # moment per unit width (1 ft) at face: m=qf*(B/2-c/2)^2/2  (lb-ft/ft)
    m1=qf*(B/2-c/2)**2/2.0  # lb-ft per ft width
    # As per ft: As=m/(phi fy (d-a/2)), phi=0.9, a=As fy/(0.85 fc 12)
    phi=0.90
    As=0.0
    # solve As: m=phi As fy (d - As fy/(1.7 fc 12))
    # iterate
    As=0.001
    for _ in range(50):
        a=As*fy/(0.85*fc*12.0)
        m_cap=phi*As*fy*(d-a/2.0)*12.0  # lb-ft per ft
        if m_cap>=m1: break
        As*=1.05
    # gross ratio = As (in2/ft) / (12in * t_in)  = As/(b*t)
    rho_gross = As/(12.0*t_in)
    # min ratio
    if t_in>36.0:
        rho_min=0.0015
    else:
        rho_min=0.0018
    return max(rho_gross,rho_min), rho_min

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stability checks for W1 (sliding, overturning middle-third, uplift)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def wall_stability(pad, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0; Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    gsoil=STRATA["I"]["gamma"]; phi=STRATA["I"]["phi"]
    w=LOADS[pad]["W1"]
    P_dlpw,H_dlpw,M_dlpw = w[5],w[6],w[7]  # service D+L+W
    P_06d,H_06d,M_06d = w[2],w[3],w[4]     # 0.6D+W
    P_dead=w[8]; uplift=abs(w[9])
    # self weight & soil above projection
    Wf=GAMMA_CONC*B*L*t  # lb
    proj=(B - WALL_T_IN/12.0)  # ft beyond wall
    soil_depth=max(Df-t,0.0)
    Wsoil=gsoil*proj*soil_depth*L  # lb
    # eccentricity (direction of wall shear = along column line = B direction for end wall)
    e = M_dlpw/P_dlpw  # ft  (service D+L+W)
    e_in=e*12.0
    # sliding: friction on 0.6D + 0.5 passive
    V_06d=P_06d*1000.0  # lb
    tanfi=math.tan(math.radians(2.0/3.0*phi))
    fr=V_06d*tanfi
    kp=math.tan(math.radians(45+phi/2.0))**2
    Pp=0.5*gsoil*Df**2*kp*L  # lb (passive on L x Df face, sliding along column line)
    sliding_res=fr+0.5*Pp
    sliding_fs=sliding_res/(H_06d*1000.0) if H_06d>0 else 99
    # uplift
    uplift_res=0.6*(Wf+Wsoil+P_dead*1000.0)
    uplift_fs=uplift_res/(uplift*1000.0) if uplift>0 else 99
    return dict(eccentricity_in=e_in, B6_in=B_in/6.0, sliding_fs=sliding_fs, uplift_fs=uplift_fs)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cost of one foundation (spread or improved)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def round3(x): return max(math.floor(x/3.0+1e-9)*3.0, 3.0) if False else math.ceil(x/3.0-1e-9)*3.0
def cost_footing(pad, tag, B_in, L_in, t_in, rho, improved, pier_count=0, pier_depth_ft=0):
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0; Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    fc=FC[pad][0]
    vol_conc=B*L*t  # ft3
    cy=vol_conc/27.0
    steel_lb=2*rho*vol_conc*GAMMA_STEEL
    # excavation: (B+2)x(L+2)xDf, no side slopes (<4ft)
    exc=(B+2.0)*(L+2.0)*Df/27.0
    backfill=max(exc-cy,0.0)
    c=PRICE_CONC[fc]*cy+PRICE_STEEL*steel_lb+PRICE_EXC*exc+PRICE_BACKFILL*backfill
    if improved:
        pier_lf=pier_count*pier_depth_ft
        c+=PRICE_PIER_LF*pier_lf
        platform_sy=B*L*9.0  # sq ft to sq yd
        c+=PRICE_PLATFORM*platform_sy
    return c

# test
if __name__=="__main__" and False:
    pass

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Spread design: size each footing for settlement<=limit & bearing, min width
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def size_spread_one(pad, tag, target_settle=SETTLE_LIMIT_IN):
    """Find smallest footing (3in grid) for spread, meeting settlement<=target and bearing.
    Computes shear thickness first, then net pressure (incl footing+backfill) and settlement."""
    sta=FSTA[tag]
    min_w = 24 if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5") else 20
    fixed_L = WALL_LEN_FT*12 if tag=="W1" else None

        if qnet<=0.97*qa+1e-6 and s<=target_settle+1e-6:
            return (B,L,s,qnet,qa,treq)
        B+=3
    return None

def design_spread_pad(pad, target=SETTLE_LIMIT_IN):
    return {tag:size_spread_one(pad,tag,target) for tag in ["F1","F2","F3","F4","F5","W1"]}

# Improved (aggregate pier) design
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def improved_geometry_ok(B_in, L_in):

"""

Computes bearing capacity, settlement, footing sizing, stability, cost for all 36 foundations.

 "I":  {"gamma":118, "phi":26.0, "c":0.25},
 "II": {"gamma":126, "phi":33.0, "c":0.0},
 "III":{"gamma":132, "phi":38.0, "c":0.0},
}

BASE_I_A = {"CR-P1":6.0,"CR-P2":13.5,"CR-P3":5.5,"CR-P4":6.0,"CR-P5":4.5,"CR-P6":14.0}
BASE_I_B = {"CR-P1":12.5,"CR-P2":9.0,"CR-P3":7.0,"CR-P4":9.5,"CR-P5":5.5,"CR-P6":6.5}
II_THK   = {"CR-P1":14.0,"CR-P2":12.0,"CR-P3":16.0,"CR-P4":15.0,"CR-P5":18.0,"CR-P6":13.0}

# Groundwater depth below finished grade (ft)
GW = {"CR-P1":8.0,"CR-P2":9.0,"CR-P3":19.0,"CR-P4":8.0,"CR-P5":21.0,"CR-P6":8.5}

def sulf_class(pct):

S_CLASS = {p:sulf_class(SULF[p]) for p in PADS}

# Concrete f'c / max wcm (most restrictive of F,W,C,S exposure classes per UFGS 03 30 00)
# F1:0.55/3500, F3:0.40/5000, W1:0.50/4000, C1:N/A/2500, S0:N/A/2500, S1:0.50/4000, S2:0.45/4500

    fc_limit = 2500; wcm = 1.0

def base_I_at(pad, sta):
    """Interpolated base of Stratum I (ft below grade) at a station."""

    return a + (b-a)*(sta/77.0)

def es_at(pad, sta, depth_below_grade_ft):
    bi = base_I_at(pad, sta)
    ii_top = bi
    ii_bot = bi + II_THK[pad]
    if depth_below_grade_ft < bi:
        return ES_I[pad]
    elif depth_below_grade_ft < ii_bot:

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bearing capacity (Terzaghi, Meyerhof, Brinch Hansen) - drained, effective stress
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def bearing_factors(phi_deg):
    phi = math.radians(phi_deg)
    kp = math.tan(math.pi/4+phi/2)**2
    nq = kp*math.exp(math.pi*math.tan(phi))
    nc = (nq-1)/math.tan(phi) if phi_deg>0 else 5.14
    # N gamma
    ng_mey = (nq-1)*math.tan(1.4*phi)
    # Terzaghi N gamma (Coduto approx used in DM7.2 table): use tabulated
    return nc,nq,kp,ng_mey

# tabulated N factors (DM7.2 Table 5-2) at 2-deg increments; interpolate
TAB = {
26:(27,22,22, 14,12,12, 11,8.0,7.9),
33:(48,39,39, 32,26,26, 33,26,24),
38:(78,61,61, 62,49,49, 82,64,56),
}
def nfact(phi_deg):
    # returns dict with Terzaghi/Meyerhof/Hansen Nc,Nq,Ng
    # interpolate from table at 2-deg
    keys=sorted(TAB.keys())
    lo=max(k for k in keys if k<=phi_deg); hi=min(k for k in keys if k>=phi_deg)
    if lo==hi:
        t=TAB[lo]
    else:
        f=(phi_deg-lo)/(hi-lo)
        t=tuple(a+(b-a)*f for a,b in zip(TAB[lo],TAB[hi]))
    return dict(Nc=(t[0],t[1],t[2]),Nq=(t[3],t[4],t[5]),Ng=(t[6],t[7],t[8]))

def ult_bearing(pad, B, L, sta, method):
    """Gross ultimate bearing capacity (ksf) for rectangular footing B x L (ft),
    bearing in Stratum I at depth Df, groundwater correction applied.
    method: 'T','M','H' (Terzaghi, Meyerhof, Hansen)."""
    Df = BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    s = STRATA["I"]; phi=s["phi"]; c=s["c"]; gamma=s["gamma"]
    nf = nfact(phi)
    idx={'T':0,'M':1,'H':2}[method]
    Nc=nf['Nc'][idx]; Nq=nf['Nq'][idx]; Ng=nf['Ng'][idx]
    # groundwater: water table depth below base
    dw = GW[pad]-Df
    gamma_eff = gamma
    if dw < B:
        gamma_sub = gamma-GAMMA_W
        gamma_eff = gamma_sub + min(1.0,dw/max(B,1e-9))*(gamma-gamma_sub)
    sigma_D = gamma*Df/1000.0  # surcharge at base (moist, water table below footing) -> ksf
    gamma_k = gamma_eff/1000.0
    c_k = c
    # shape & depth factors
    if method=='T':
        # Terzaghi: shape by table (square/continuous). Use rectangular interp by B/L
        # square: sc=1.3,sq=1,sg=0.8 ; continuous:1,1,1
        r = min(B/L,1.0)
        sc=1+0.3*r; sq=1.0; sg=0.8+0.2*(1-r)
        # depth: Terzaghi ignores depth (set 1)
        dc=dq=dg=1.0
    elif method=='M':
        kp=math.tan(math.pi/4+math.radians(phi)/2)**2
        r=B/L
        sc=1+0.2*r*kp; sq=1+0.1*r*kp; sg=1+0.1*r*kp
        k=Df/B
        dc=1+0.2*k*math.sqrt(kp); dq=1+0.1*k*math.sqrt(kp); dg=1+0.1*k*math.sqrt(kp)
    else: # Hansen
        kp=math.tan(math.pi/4+math.radians(phi)/2)**2
        r=B/L
        sc=1+0.2*r; sq=1+0.1*r; sg=1-0.2*r  # approx Hansen shape
        k=Df/B
        dc=1+0.4*k; dq=1+2*math.tan(phi*math.pi/180)*(1-math.sin(phi*math.pi/180))**2*k; dg=1.0
    q_ult = c_k*Nc*sc*dc + sigma_D*Nq*sq*dq + 0.5*gamma_k*B*Ng*sg*dg
    return q_ult

def q_allow_net(pad, B, L, sta, method='M'):
    q_ult = ult_bearing(pad,B,L,sta,method)
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    sigma_D = STRATA["I"]["gamma"]*Df/1000.0
    return q_ult/FS[pad] - sigma_D   # gross-based net allowable (conservative)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def settlement_in(pad, B, L, sta, q_net_ksf, start_z=0.0, dz=0.25):
    """Settlement (in) from layered elastic compression. q_net in ksf (net pressure).
    Integrates from start_z to depth = max(4B,40) below bearing surface."""
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    depth = max(4.0*B, 40.0)
    if start_z>=depth: return 0.0
    s=0.0
    z=start_z+dz/2.0
    while z < depth:
        # 2V:1H stress spread
        dsig = q_net_ksf*(B*L)/((B+z)*(L+z))
        dbg = Df+z
        es = es_at(pad, sta, dbg)  # ksf
        s += dsig*dz/es  # ft
        z += dz
    return s*12.0  # to inches

def footing_self_weight_kips(B,L,t_ft):
    return GAMMA_CONC*B*L*t_ft/1000.0  # kips

def service_P(pad,tag):

def q_gross_ksf(pad, tag, B, L, t_ft):
    # gross applied bearing pressure incl footing self weight + backfill (ksf)
    P = service_P(pad,tag)
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    gsoil=STRATA["I"]["gamma"]
    return (P*1000.0 + GAMMA_CONC*t_ft*1000.0 + gsoil*(Df-t_ft)*1000.0)/(B*L*1000.0)

def q_net_applied(pad, tag, B, L, t_ft):
    # physical net = gross - overburden (incl backfill which cancels)
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    return q_gross_ksf(pad,tag,B,L,t_ft) - STRATA["I"]["gamma"]*Df/1000.0  # ksf

# Footing thickness from shear (one-way & two-way), flexural steel
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def shear_thickness_in(pad, tag, B_in, L_in):
    """Required thickness (in) from one-way and two-way (punching) shear.
    Returns required d (in) then t=d+4 (rounded). Uses phi=0.75 (EM 1110-2-2104)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0
    fc = FC[pad][0]
    phishear=0.75
    sqf=math.sqrt(fc)  # psi
    # factored net bearing pressure (ksf) -> psi
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]
    # net factored pressure ~ Pf/(B*L) + 1.2*(gamma_conc-gamma_soil)*t  (small, ignore t term)
    qf = Pf/(B*L)  # ksf  (gross factored, conservative for shear)
    qf_psf=qf*1000.0
    # iterate d
    d=12.0
    for _ in range(60):
        dft=d/12.0
        if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
            c=FCOL[tag]/12.0  # column side ft
            # one-way shear: critical at d from face. Vu = qf*B*(B/2 - c/2 - dft) on one side
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*B*max(a1,0.0)  # lb (per the strip)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*B*12.0*d  # phi later; b in inches = B*12
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way punching: bo=4*(c+dft), Vu=qf*(B*B - (c+dft)^2) for square footing B=B=L? use B,L
            bo=4*(c+dft)
            area_punch=max((c+dft)**2,0.0)
            Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*B - area_punch,0.0)  # assumes square B=L; for rect use B*L
            if B!=L:
                area_punch=(c+dft)**2  # square column
                Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*L-area_punch,0.0)
            Vc2=4*sqf*bo*12.0*d
            d_req2=Vu2/(phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0) if (phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0)>0 else 0
        else:
            # wall footing: one-way shear across width B (wall c=1ft=12in, length L)
            c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*L*max(a1,0.0)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*L*12.0*d
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way: wall is long -> punching only at wall ends; check one-way governs. d_req2=0
            d_req2=0.0
        d_new=max(d_req1,d_req2,8.0)
        if abs(d_new-d)<0.01: 
            d=d_new; break
        d=d_new
    t=d+4.0
    # round up to nearest 3 in
    t3=math.ceil(t/3.0)*3.0
    return max(t3,12.0), d

def flex_steel_ratio(pad, tag, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    """Required gross reinforcement ratio (As/(b*t)) from flexure (each direction)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0
    d=(t_in-4.0)/12.0  # ft
    fc=FC[pad][0]; fy=60000.0
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]; c=FCOL[tag]/12.0
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]; c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
    qf=Pf/(B*L)*1000.0  # psf factored
    # moment per unit width (1 ft) at face: m=qf*(B/2-c/2)^2/2  (lb-ft/ft)
    m1=qf*(B/2-c/2)**2/2.0  # lb-ft per ft width
    # As per ft: As=m/(phi fy (d-a/2)), phi=0.9, a=As fy/(0.85 fc 12)
    phi=0.90
    As=0.0
    # solve As: m=phi As fy (d - As fy/(1.7 fc 12))
    # iterate
    As=0.001
    for _ in range(50):
        a=As*fy/(0.85*fc*12.0)
        m_cap=phi*As*fy*(d-a/2.0)*12.0  # lb-ft per ft
        if m_cap>=m1: break
        As*=1.05
    # gross ratio = As (in2/ft) / (12in * t_in)  = As/(b*t)
    rho_gross = As/(12.0*t_in)
    # min ratio
    if t_in>36.0:
        rho_min=0.0015
    else:
        rho_min=0.0018
    return max(rho_gross,rho_min), rho_min

# Stability checks for W1 (sliding, overturning middle-third, uplift)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def wall_stability(pad, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0; Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    gsoil=STRATA["I"]["gamma"]; phi=STRATA["I"]["phi"]
    w=LOADS[pad]["W1"]
    P_dlpw,H_dlpw,M_dlpw = w[5],w[6],w[7]  # service D+L+W
    P_06d,H_06d,M_06d = w[2],w[3],w[4]     # 0.6D+W
    P_dead=w[8]; uplift=abs(w[9])
    # self weight & soil above projection
    Wf=GAMMA_CONC*B*L*t  # lb
    proj=(B - WALL_T_IN/12.0)  # ft beyond wall
    soil_depth=max(Df-t,0.0)
    Wsoil=gsoil*proj*soil_depth*L  # lb
    # eccentricity (direction of wall shear = along column line = B direction for end wall)
    e = M_dlpw/P_dlpw  # ft  (service D+L+W)
    e_in=e*12.0
    # sliding: friction on 0.6D + 0.5 passive
    V_06d=P_06d*1000.0  # lb
    tanfi=math.tan(math.radians(2.0/3.0*phi))
    fr=V_06d*tanfi
    kp=math.tan(math.radians(45+phi/2.0))**2
    Pp=0.5*gsoil*Df**2*kp*L  # lb (passive on L x Df face, sliding along column line)
    sliding_res=fr+0.5*Pp
    sliding_fs=sliding_res/(H_06d*1000.0) if H_06d>0 else 99
    # uplift
    uplift_res=0.6*(Wf+Wsoil+P_dead*1000.0)
    uplift_fs=uplift_res/(uplift*1000.0) if uplift>0 else 99
    return dict(eccentricity_in=e_in, B6_in=B_in/6.0, sliding_fs=sliding_fs, uplift_fs=uplift_fs)

def round3(x): return max(math.floor(x/3.0+1e-9)*3.0, 3.0) if False else math.ceil(x/3.0-1e-9)*3.0
def cost_footing(pad, tag, B_in, L_in, t_in, rho, improved, pier_count=0, pier_depth_ft=0):
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0; Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    fc=FC[pad][0]
    vol_conc=B*L*t  # ft3
    cy=vol_conc/27.0
    steel_lb=2*rho*vol_conc*GAMMA_STEEL
    # excavation: (B+2)x(L+2)xDf, no side slopes (<4ft)
    exc=(B+2.0)*(L+2.0)*Df/27.0
    backfill=max(exc-cy,0.0)
    c=PRICE_CONC[fc]*cy+PRICE_STEEL*steel_lb+PRICE_EXC*exc+PRICE_BACKFILL*backfill
    if improved:
        pier_lf=pier_count*pier_depth_ft
        c+=PRICE_PIER_LF*pier_lf
        platform_sy=B*L*9.0  # sq ft to sq yd
        c+=PRICE_PLATFORM*platform_sy
    return c

    Computes shear thickness first, then net pressure (incl footing+backfill) and settlement."""
    sta=FSTA[tag]
    min_w = 24 if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5") else 20
    fixed_L = WALL_LEN_FT*12 if tag=="W1" else None
    B=round3(min_w)

        treq,_=shear_thickness_in(pad,tag,B,L)
        qnet=q_net_applied(pad,tag,B/12.0,L/12.0,treq/12.0)
        qa=q_allow_net(pad,B/12.0,L/12.0,sta,'M')
        s=settlement_in(pad,B/12.0,L/12.0,sta,qnet)

# W1 tuple: (P_service, P_factored, P_0.6D, H_0.6DW, M_0.6DW, P_DLPW, H_DLPW, M_DLPW, P_dead, uplift)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Geometry helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def base_I_at(pad, sta):
    """Interpolated base of Stratum I (ft below grade) at a station."""
    a = BASE_I_A[pad]; b = BASE_I_B[pad]
    return a + (b-a)*(sta/77.0)

def es_at(pad, sta, depth_below_grade_ft):
    bi = base_I_at(pad, sta)
    ii_top = bi
    ii_bot = bi + II_THK[pad]
    if depth_below_grade_ft < bi:
        return ES_I[pad]
    elif depth_below_grade_ft < ii_bot:
        return ES_II[pad]
    else:
        return ES_III[pad]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bearing capacity (Terzaghi, Meyerhof, Brinch Hansen) - drained, effective stress
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def bearing_factors(phi_deg):
    phi = math.radians(phi_deg)
    kp = math.tan(math.pi/4+phi/2)**2
    nq = kp*math.exp(math.pi*math.tan(phi))
    nc = (nq-1)/math.tan(phi) if phi_deg>0 else 5.14
    # N gamma
    ng_mey = (nq-1)*math.tan(1.4*phi)
    # Terzaghi N gamma (Coduto approx used in DM7.2 table): use tabulated
    return nc,nq,kp,ng_mey

# tabulated N factors (DM7.2 Table 5-2) at 2-deg increments; interpolate
TAB = {
26:(27,22,22, 14,12,12, 11,8.0,7.9),
33:(48,39,39, 32,26,26, 33,26,24),
38:(78,61,61, 62,49,49, 82,64,56),
}
def nfact(phi_deg):
    # returns dict with Terzaghi/Meyerhof/Hansen Nc,Nq,Ng
    # interpolate from table at 2-deg
    keys=sorted(TAB.keys())
    lo=max(k for k in keys if k<=phi_deg); hi=min(k for k in keys if k>=phi_deg)
    if lo==hi:
        t=TAB[lo]
    else:
        f=(phi_deg-lo)/(hi-lo)
        t=tuple(a+(b-a)*f for a,b in zip(TAB[lo],TAB[hi]))
    return dict(Nc=(t[0],t[1],t[2]),Nq=(t[3],t[4],t[5]),Ng=(t[6],t[7],t[8]))

def ult_bearing(pad, B, L, sta, method):
    """Gross ultimate bearing capacity (ksf) for rectangular footing B x L (ft),
    bearing in Stratum I at depth Df, groundwater correction applied.
    method: 'T','M','H' (Terzaghi, Meyerhof, Hansen)."""
    Df = BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    s = STRATA["I"]; phi=s["phi"]; c=s["c"]; gamma=s["gamma"]
    nf = nfact(phi)
    idx={'T':0,'M':1,'H':2}[method]
    Nc=nf['Nc'][idx]; Nq=nf['Nq'][idx]; Ng=nf['Ng'][idx]
    # groundwater: water table depth below base
    dw = GW[pad]-Df
    gamma_eff = gamma
    if dw < B:
        gamma_sub = gamma-GAMMA_W
        gamma_eff = gamma_sub + min(1.0,dw/max(B,1e-9))*(gamma-gamma_sub)
    sigma_D = gamma*Df/1000.0  # surcharge at base (moist, water table below footing) -> ksf
    gamma_k = gamma_eff/1000.0
    c_k = c
    # shape & depth factors
    if method=='T':
        # Terzaghi: shape by table (square/continuous). Use rectangular interp by B/L
        # square: sc=1.3,sq=1,sg=0.8 ; continuous:1,1,1
        r = min(B/L,1.0)
        sc=1+0.3*r; sq=1.0; sg=0.8+0.2*(1-r)
        # depth: Terzaghi ignores depth (set 1)
        dc=dq=dg=1.0
    elif method=='M':
        kp=math.tan(math.pi/4+math.radians(phi)/2)**2
        r=B/L
        sc=1+0.2*r*kp; sq=1+0.1*r*kp; sg=1+0.1*r*kp
        k=Df/B
        dc=1+0.2*k*math.sqrt(kp); dq=1+0.1*k*math.sqrt(kp); dg=1+0.1*k*math.sqrt(kp)
    else: # Hansen
        kp=math.tan(math.pi/4+math.radians(phi)/2)**2
        r=B/L
        sc=1+0.2*r; sq=1+0.1*r; sg=1-0.2*r  # approx Hansen shape
        k=Df/B
        dc=1+0.4*k; dq=1+2*math.tan(phi*math.pi/180)*(1-math.sin(phi*math.pi/180))**2*k; dg=1.0
    q_ult = c_k*Nc*sc*dc + sigma_D*Nq*sq*dq + 0.5*gamma_k*B*Ng*sg*dg
    return q_ult

def q_allow_net(pad, B, L, sta, method='M'):
    q_ult = ult_bearing(pad,B,L,sta,method)
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    sigma_D = STRATA["I"]["gamma"]*Df/1000.0
    return q_ult/FS[pad] - sigma_D   # gross-based net allowable (conservative)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Settlement - layered elastic, 2V:1H, 0.25 ft layers, depth = max(4B,40)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def settlement_in(pad, B, L, sta, q_net_ksf, start_z=0.0, dz=0.25):
    """Settlement (in) from layered elastic compression. q_net in ksf (net pressure).
    Integrates from start_z to depth = max(4B,40) below bearing surface."""
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    depth = max(4.0*B, 40.0)
    if start_z>=depth: return 0.0
    s=0.0
    z=start_z+dz/2.0
    while z < depth:
        # 2V:1H stress spread
        dsig = q_net_ksf*(B*L)/((B+z)*(L+z))
        dbg = Df+z
        es = es_at(pad, sta, dbg)  # ksf
        s += dsig*dz/es  # ft
        z += dz
    return s*12.0  # to inches

def footing_self_weight_kips(B,L,t_ft):
    return GAMMA_CONC*B*L*t_ft/1000.0  # kips

def service_P(pad,tag):
    return LOADS[pad][tag][0] if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5") else LOADS[pad]["W1"][0]
def factored_P(pad,tag):
    return LOADS[pad][tag][1] if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5") else LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]

def q_gross_ksf(pad, tag, B, L, t_ft):
    # gross applied bearing pressure incl footing self weight + backfill (ksf)
    P = service_P(pad,tag)
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    gsoil=STRATA["I"]["gamma"]
    return P/(B*L) + (GAMMA_CONC*t_ft + gsoil*(Df-t_ft))/1000.0

def q_net_applied(pad, tag, B, L, t_ft):
    # physical net = gross - overburden (incl backfill which cancels)
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    return q_gross_ksf(pad,tag,B,L,t_ft) - STRATA["I"]["gamma"]*Df/1000.0  # ksf

if __name__=="__main__":
    for pad in PADS:
        print(pad, "FS",FS[pad],"sulf",SULF[pad],S_CLASS[pad],"fc",FC[pad][0],"wcm",FC[pad][1],"classes",FC[pad][2])
        for tag in ["F1","F2","F3","F4","F5","W1"]:
            sta=FSTA[tag]
            bi=base_I_at(pad,sta)
            print(f"  {tag} sta={sta} baseI={bi:.2f} StratumI_below={bi-BEARING_DEPTH_FT:.2f}ft")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Footing thickness from shear (one-way & two-way), flexural steel
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def shear_thickness_in(pad, tag, B_in, L_in):
    """Required thickness (in) from one-way and two-way (punching) shear.
    Returns required d (in) then t=d+4 (rounded). Uses phi=0.75 (EM 1110-2-2104)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0
    fc = FC[pad][0]
    phishear=0.75
    sqf=math.sqrt(fc)  # psi
    # factored net bearing pressure (ksf) -> psi
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]
    # net factored pressure ~ Pf/(B*L) + 1.2*(gamma_conc-gamma_soil)*t  (small, ignore t term)
    qf = Pf/(B*L)  # ksf  (gross factored, conservative for shear)
    qf_psf=qf*1000.0
    # iterate d
    d=12.0
    for _ in range(60):
        dft=d/12.0
        if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
            c=FCOL[tag]/12.0  # column side ft
            # one-way shear: critical at d from face. Vu = qf*B*(B/2 - c/2 - dft) on one side
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*B*max(a1,0.0)  # lb (per the strip)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*B*12.0*d  # phi later; b in inches = B*12
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way punching: bo=4*(c+dft), Vu=qf*(B*B - (c+dft)^2) for square footing B=B=L? use B,L
            bo=4*(c+dft)
            area_punch=max((c+dft)**2,0.0)
            Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*B - area_punch,0.0)  # assumes square B=L; for rect use B*L
            if B!=L:
                area_punch=(c+dft)**2  # square column
                Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*L-area_punch,0.0)
            Vc2=4*sqf*bo*12.0*d
            d_req2=Vu2/(phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0) if (phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0)>0 else 0
        else:
            # wall footing: one-way shear across width B (wall c=1ft=12in, length L)
            c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*L*max(a1,0.0)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*L*12.0*d
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way: wall is long -> punching only at wall ends; check one-way governs. d_req2=0
            d_req2=0.0
        d_new=max(d_req1,d_req2,8.0)
        if abs(d_new-d)<0.01: 
            d=d_new; break
        d=d_new
    t=d+4.0
    # round up to nearest 3 in
    t3=math.ceil(t/3.0)*3.0
    return max(t3,12.0), d

def flex_steel_ratio(pad, tag, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    """Required gross reinforcement ratio (As/(b*t)) from flexure (each direction)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0
    d=(t_in-4.0)/12.0  # ft
    fc=FC[pad][0]; fy=60000.0
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]; c=FCOL[tag]/12.0
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]; c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
    qf=Pf/(B*L)*1000.0  # psf factored
    # moment per unit width (1 ft) at face: m=qf*(B/2-c/2)^2/2  (lb-ft/ft)
    m1=qf*(B/2-c/2)**2/2.0  # lb-ft per ft width
    # As per ft: As=m/(phi fy (d-a/2)), phi=0.9, a=As fy/(0.85 fc 12)
    phi=0.90
    As=0.0
    # solve As: m=phi As fy (d - As fy/(1.7 fc 12))
    # iterate
    As=0.001
    for _ in range(50):
        a=As*fy/(0.85*fc*12.0)
        m_cap=phi*As*fy*(d-a/2.0)*12.0  # lb-ft per ft
        if m_cap>=m1: break
        As*=1.05
    # gross ratio = As (in2/ft) / (12in * t_in)  = As/(b*t)
    rho_gross = As/(12.0*t_in)
    # min ratio
    if t_in>36.0:
        rho_min=0.0015
    else:
        rho_min=0.0018
    return max(rho_gross,rho_min), rho_min

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stability checks for W1 (sliding, overturning middle-third, uplift)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def wall_stability(pad, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0; Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    gsoil=STRATA["I"]["gamma"]; phi=STRATA["I"]["phi"]
    w=LOADS[pad]["W1"]

    P_06d,H_06d,M_06d = w[2],w[3],w[4]     # 0.6D+W
    P_dead=w[8]; uplift=abs(w[9])
    # self weight & soil above projection
    Wf=GAMMA_CONC*B*L*t  # lb
    proj=(B - WALL_T_IN/12.0)  # ft beyond wall
    soil_depth=max(Df-t,0.0)
    Wsoil=gsoil*proj*soil_depth*L  # lb
    # eccentricity (direction of wall shear = along column line = B direction for end wall)
    e = M_dlpw/P_dlpw  # ft  (service D+L+W)
    e_in=e*12.0
    # sliding: friction on 0.6D + 0.5 passive
    V_06d=P_06d*1000.0  # lb
    tanfi=math.tan(math.radians(2.0/3.0*phi))
    fr=V_06d*tanfi
    kp=math.tan(math.radians(45+phi/2.0))**2
    Pp=0.5*gsoil*Df**2*kp*L  # lb (passive on L x Df face, sliding along column line)
    sliding_res=fr+0.5*Pp

    # uplift

    uplift_fs=uplift_res/(uplift*1000.0) if uplift>0 else 99
    return dict(eccentricity_in=e_in, B6_in=B_in/6.0, sliding_fs=sliding_fs, uplift_fs=uplift_fs)

def cost_footing(pad, tag, B_in, L_in, t_in, rho, improved, pier_count=0, pier_depth_ft=0):

"""Build the six deliverables for the Cattail Run foundation strategy."""
import math, json, os, zipfile

import engine as E

OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "output")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

# ---- Campus decision (from engine optimization) ----
IMPROVED = ["CR-P1","CR-P2","CR-P6"]
SPREAD_PADS = ["CR-P3","CR-P4","CR-P5"]
RIGS = {"RIG-1":["CR-P1","CR-P2"], "RIG-2":["CR-P6"]}
N_RIGS = len(RIGS)
MOB = N_RIGS*E.PRICE_MOB

PAD_GOVERN = {}  # filled below

def pad_footing_cost(des, improved):
    tot=0; lf=0; maxT=0
    for tag in E.ORDER:
        r=des[tag]
        tot+=E.cost_footing(pad_global,tag,r["B_in"],r["L_in"],r["thickness_in"],
                            r["reinforcement_ratio"],improved,r["pier_count"],r["pier_depth_ft"]) if False else 0
    return tot

# Compute designs
designs={}; spread_cost={}; improved_cost={}; spread_des={}; improved_des={}
for pad in E.PADS:
    s_des=E.final_design(pad, False)
    i_des=E.final_design(pad, True)
    spread_des[pad]=s_des; improved_des[pad]=i_des
    # footing+test costs (excl mobilization)
    sc=sum(E.cost_footing(pad,t,r["B_in"],r["L_in"],r["thickness_in"],r["reinforcement_ratio"],False,0,0) for t,r in s_des.items())
    ic=sum(E.cost_footing(pad,t,r["B_in"],r["L_in"],r["thickness_in"],r["reinforcement_ratio"],True,r["pier_count"],r["pier_depth_ft"]) for t,r in i_des.items())+E.PRICE_MODTEST
    spread_cost[pad]=sc; improved_cost[pad]=ic
    designs[pad]=i_des if pad in IMPROVED else s_des

campus_total = sum(improved_cost[p] if p in IMPROVED else spread_cost[p] for p in E.PADS) + MOB

print("Campus total $%.0f  mob $%.0f  rigs %d"%(campus_total,MOB,N_RIGS))
for p in E.PADS:
    print(" %s %s  spread $%.0f  improved $%.0f"%(p,"IMPROVED" if p in IMPROVED else "SPREAD",spread_cost[p],improved_cost[p]))

# ---- Determine governing constraint per pad ----
def gov_constraint(pad, des, improved):
    # ratios
    s_max=max(r["settlement_in"] for r in des.values())/E.SETTLE_LIMIT_IN
    q_max=max(r["q_net_ksf"]/r["q_allow_net_ksf"] for r in des.values())
    rows,mx=E.angular_check(pad,des)
    ang_ratio=mx/E.ANG_DIST_LIMIT
    # stability for W1
    w1=des["W1"]
    slid=w1.get("sliding_fs",99)/1.5; up=w1.get("uplift_fs",99)/1.5
    e_ratio=w1.get("eccentricity_in",0)/(w1["B_in"]/6.0) if w1["B_in"]>0 else 0
    # pick the binding one >=0.8 that selects design
    cands=[]
    if improved:
        # top-of-pier stress (a bearing check) often binding
        tps=max(r["top_of_pier_stress_psf"] for r in des.values())/E.PIER_MAX_TOPSTRESS_PSF
    else:
        tps=0.0
    # priority: settlement (the driver), then angular, then bearing/tps
    if s_max>=0.8: return "SETTLEMENT", s_max, q_max, ang_ratio, tps
    if ang_ratio>=0.8: return "ANGULAR_DISTORTION", s_max, q_max, ang_ratio, tps
    if tps>=0.8 or q_max>=0.8: return "BEARING", s_max, q_max, ang_ratio, tps
    if e_ratio>=0.8: return "OVERTURNING", s_max, q_max, ang_ratio, tps
    if slid<1.0: return "SLIDING", s_max, q_max, ang_ratio, tps
    if up<1.0: return "UPLIFT", s_max, q_max, ang_ratio, tps
    # fallback: the largest ratio
    return "SETTLEMENT", s_max, q_max, ang_ratio, tps

for pad in E.PADS:
    g,sm,qm,am,tpm=gov_constraint(pad,designs[pad],pad in IMPROVED)
    PAD_GOVERN[pad]=g
    print("GOV %s %s s=%.2f q=%.2f ang=%.2f tps=%.2f"%(pad,g,sm,qm,am,tpm))

from openpyxl import Workbook

def fper_footing_gov(pad, tag, r, improved, ang_rows):
    s_ratio=r["settlement_in"]/E.SETTLE_LIMIT_IN
    if improved:
        tps_ratio=r["top_of_pier_stress_psf"]/E.PIER_MAX_TOPSTRESS_PSF
        q_ratio=0.0
    else:
        tps_ratio=0.0
        q_ratio=r["q_net_ksf"]/r["q_allow_net_ksf"] if r["q_allow_net_ksf"]>0 else 0
    # angular for this footing = max of its adjacent pairs
    ar=0.0
    for (t1,t2,ds,span,ang,ok) in ang_rows:
        if t1==tag or t2==tag: ar=max(ar,ang/E.ANG_DIST_LIMIT)
    ratios=[("SETTLEMENT",s_ratio),("BEARING",max(q_ratio,tps_ratio)),("ANGULAR_DISTORTION",ar)]
    if tag=="W1":
        ratios.append(("OVERTURNING", r.get("eccentricity_in",0)/(r["B_in"]/6.0) if r["B_in"]>0 else 0))
        ratios.append(("SLIDING", 1.5/r.get("sliding_fs",99)))
        ratios.append(("UPLIFT", 1.5/r.get("uplift_fs",99)))
    ratios.sort(key=lambda x:-x[1])
    return ratios[0][0] if ratios[0][1]>=0.8 else ratios[0][0]

    proj=(B - WALL_T_IN/12.0)  # ft beyond wall
    soil_depth=max(Df-t,0.0)
    Wsoil=gsoil*proj*soil_depth*L  # lb
    # eccentricity (direction of wall shear = along column line = B direction for end wall)
    e = M_dlpw/P_dlpw  # ft  (service D+L+W)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bearing capacity (Terzaghi, Meyerhof, Brinch Hansen) - drained, effective stress

def bearing_factors(phi_deg):
    phi = math.radians(phi_deg)
    kp = math.tan(math.pi/4+phi/2)**2
    nq = kp*math.exp(math.pi*math.tan(phi))
    nc = (nq-1)/math.tan(phi) if phi_deg>0 else 5.14
    # N gamma
    ng_mey = (nq-1)*math.tan(1.4*phi)
    # Terzaghi N gamma (Coduto approx used in DM7.2 table): use tabulated
    return nc,nq,kp,ng_mey

# tabulated N factors (DM7.2 Table 5-2) at 2-deg increments; interpolate
TAB = {
26:(27,22,22, 14,12,12, 11,8.0,7.9),
33:(48,39,39, 32,26,26, 33,26,24),
38:(78,61,61, 62,49,49, 82,64,56),
}
def nfact(phi_deg):
    # returns dict with Terzaghi/Meyerhof/Hansen Nc,Nq,Ng
    # interpolate from table at 2-deg
    keys=sorted(TAB.keys())
    lo=max(k for k in keys if k<=phi_deg); hi=min(k for k in keys if k>=phi_deg)
    if lo==hi:
        t=TAB[lo]
    else:
        f=(phi_deg-lo)/(hi-lo)
        t=tuple(a+(b-a)*f for a,b in zip(TAB[lo],TAB[hi]))
    return dict(Nc=(t[0],t[1],t[2]),Nq=(t[3],t[4],t[5]),Ng=(t[6],t[7],t[8]))

def ult_bearing(pad, B, L, sta, method):
    """Gross ultimate bearing capacity (ksf) for rectangular footing B x L (ft),
    bearing in Stratum I at depth Df, groundwater correction applied.
    method: 'T','M','H' (Terzaghi, Meyerhof, Hansen)."""
    Df = BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    s = STRATA["I"]; phi=s["phi"]; c=s["c"]; gamma=s["gamma"]
    nf = nfact(phi)
    idx={'T':0,'M':1,'H':2}[method]
    Nc=nf['Nc'][idx]; Nq=nf['Nq'][idx]; Ng=nf['Ng'][idx]
    # groundwater: water table depth below base
    dw = GW[pad]-Df
    gamma_eff = gamma
    if dw < B:
        gamma_sub = gamma-GAMMA_W
        gamma_eff = gamma_sub + min(1.0,dw/max(B,1e-9))*(gamma-gamma_sub)
    sigma_D = gamma*Df/1000.0  # surcharge at base (moist, water table below footing) -> ksf
    gamma_k = gamma_eff/1000.0
    c_k = c
    # shape & depth factors
    if method=='T':
        # Terzaghi: shape by table (square/continuous). Use rectangular interp by B/L
        # square: sc=1.3,sq=1,sg=0.8 ; continuous:1,1,1
        r = min(B/L,1.0)
        sc=1+0.3*r; sq=1.0; sg=0.8+0.2*(1-r)
        # depth: Terzaghi ignores depth (set 1)
        dc=dq=dg=1.0
    elif method=='M':
        kp=math.tan(math.pi/4+math.radians(phi)/2)**2
        r=B/L
        sc=1+0.2*r*kp; sq=1+0.1*r*kp; sg=1+0.1*r*kp
        k=Df/B
        dc=1+0.2*k*math.sqrt(kp); dq=1+0.1*k*math.sqrt(kp); dg=1+0.1*k*math.sqrt(kp)
    else: # Hansen
        kp=math.tan(math.pi/4+math.radians(phi)/2)**2
        r=B/L
        sc=1+0.2*r; sq=1+0.1*r; sg=1-0.2*r  # approx Hansen shape
        k=Df/B
        dc=1+0.4*k; dq=1+2*math.tan(phi*math.pi/180)*(1-math.sin(phi*math.pi/180))**2*k; dg=1.0
    q_ult = c_k*Nc*sc*dc + sigma_D*Nq*sq*dq + 0.5*gamma_k*B*Ng*sg*dg
    return q_ult

def q_allow_net(pad, B, L, sta, method='M'):
    q_ult = ult_bearing(pad,B,L,sta,method)
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    sigma_D = STRATA["I"]["gamma"]*Df/1000.0
    return q_ult/FS[pad] - sigma_D   # gross-based net allowable (conservative)

def settlement_in(pad, B, L, sta, q_net_ksf, start_z=0.0, dz=0.25):
    """Settlement (in) from layered elastic compression. q_net in ksf (net pressure).
    Integrates from start_z to depth = max(4B,40) below bearing surface."""
    Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    depth = max(4.0*B, 40.0)
    if start_z>=depth: return 0.0
    s=0.0
    z=start_z+dz/2.0
    while z < depth:
        # 2V:1H stress spread
        dsig = q_net_ksf*(B*L)/((B+z)*(L+z))
        dbg = Df+z
        es = es_at(pad, sta, dbg)  # ksf
        s += dsig*dz/es  # ft
        z += dz
    return s*12.0  # to inches

def shear_thickness_in(pad, tag, B_in, L_in):
    """Required thickness (in) from one-way and two-way (punching) shear.
    Returns required d (in) then t=d+4 (rounded). Uses phi=0.75 (EM 1110-2-2104)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0
    fc = FC[pad][0]
    phishear=0.75
    sqf=math.sqrt(fc)  # psi
    # factored net bearing pressure (ksf) -> psi
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]
    # net factored pressure ~ Pf/(B*L) + 1.2*(gamma_conc-gamma_soil)*t  (small, ignore t term)
    qf = Pf/(B*L)  # ksf  (gross factored, conservative for shear)
    qf_psf=qf*1000.0
    # iterate d
    d=12.0
    for _ in range(60):
        dft=d/12.0
        if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
            c=FCOL[tag]/12.0  # column side ft
            # one-way shear: critical at d from face. Vu = qf*B*(B/2 - c/2 - dft) on one side
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*B*max(a1,0.0)  # lb (per the strip)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*B*12.0*d  # phi later; b in inches = B*12
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*B*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way punching: bo=4*(c+dft), Vu=qf*(B*B - (c+dft)^2) for square footing B=B=L? use B,L
            bo=4*(c+dft)
            area_punch=max((c+dft)**2,0.0)
            Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*B - area_punch,0.0)  # assumes square B=L; for rect use B*L
            if B!=L:
                area_punch=(c+dft)**2  # square column
                Vu2=qf_psf*max(B*L-area_punch,0.0)
            Vc2=4*sqf*bo*12.0*d
            d_req2=Vu2/(phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0) if (phishear*4*sqf*bo*12.0)>0 else 0
        else:
            # wall footing: one-way shear across width B (wall c=1ft=12in, length L)
            c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
            a1 = B/2 - c/2 - dft
            Vu1 = qf_psf*L*max(a1,0.0)
            Vc1 = 2*sqf*L*12.0*d
            d_req1 = Vu1/(phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0) if (phishear*2*sqf*L*12.0)>0 else 0
            # two-way: wall is long -> punching only at wall ends; check one-way governs. d_req2=0
            d_req2=0.0
        d_new=max(d_req1,d_req2,8.0)
        if abs(d_new-d)<0.01: 
            d=d_new; break
        d=d_new
    t=d+4.0
    # round up to nearest 3 in
    t3=math.ceil(t/3.0)*3.0
    return max(t3,12.0), d

def flex_steel_ratio(pad, tag, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    """Required gross reinforcement ratio (As/(b*t)) from flexure (each direction)."""
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0
    d=(t_in-4.0)/12.0  # ft
    fc=FC[pad][0]; fy=60000.0
    if tag in ("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5"):
        Pf=LOADS[pad][tag][1]; c=FCOL[tag]/12.0
    else:
        Pf=LOADS[pad]["W1"][1]; c=WALL_T_IN/12.0
    qf=Pf/(B*L)*1000.0  # psf factored
    # moment per unit width (1 ft) at face: m=qf*(B/2-c/2)^2/2  (lb-ft/ft)
    m1=qf*(B/2-c/2)**2/2.0  # lb-ft per ft width
    # As per ft: As=m/(phi fy (d-a/2)), phi=0.9, a=As fy/(0.85 fc 12)
    phi=0.90
    As=0.0
    # solve As: m=phi As fy (d - As fy/(1.7 fc 12))
    # iterate
    As=0.001
    for _ in range(50):
        a=As*fy/(0.85*fc*12.0)
        m_cap=phi*As*fy*(d-a/2.0)*12.0  # lb-ft per ft
        if m_cap>=m1: break
        As*=1.05
    # gross ratio = As (in2/ft) / (12in * t_in)  = As/(b*t)
    rho_gross = As/(12.0*t_in)
    # min ratio
    if t_in>36.0:
        rho_min=0.0015
    else:
        rho_min=0.0018
    return max(rho_gross,rho_min), rho_min

def wall_stability(pad, B_in, L_in, t_in):
    B=B_in/12.0; L=L_in/12.0; t=t_in/12.0; Df=BEARING_DEPTH_FT
    gsoil=STRATA["I"]["gamma"]; phi=STRATA["I"]["phi"]
    w=LOADS[pad]["W1"]
    P_dlpw,H_dlpw,M_dlpw = w[5],w[6],w[7]  # service D+L+W
    P_06d,H_06d,M_06d = w[2],w[3],w[4]     # 0.6D+W
    P_dead=w[8]; uplift=abs(w[9])
    # self weight & soil above projection
    Wf=GAMMA_CONC*B*L*t  # lb
    proj=(B - WALL_T_IN/12.0)  # ft beyond wall
    soil_depth=max(Df-t,0.0)
    Wsoil=gsoil*proj*soil_depth*L  # lb
    # eccentricity (direction of wall shear = along column line = B direction for end wall)
    e = M_dlpw/P_dlpw  # ft  (service D+L+W)
    e_in=e*12.0
    # sliding: friction on 0.6D + 0.5 passive
    V_06d=P_06d*1000.0  # lb
    tanfi=math.tan(math.radians(2.0/3.0*phi))
    fr=V_06d*tanfi
    kp=math.tan(math.radians(45+phi/2.0))**2
    Pp=0.5*gsoil*Df**2*kp*L  # lb (passive on L x Df face, sliding along column line)
    sliding_res=fr+0.5*Pp
    sliding_fs=sliding_res/(H_06d*1000.0) if H_06d>0 else 99
    # uplift
    uplift_res=0.6*(Wf+Wsoil+P_dead*1000.0)
    uplift_fs=uplift_res/(uplift*1000.0) if uplift>0 else 99
    return dict(eccentricity_in=e_in, B6_in=B_in/6.0, sliding_fs=sliding_fs, uplift_fs=uplift_fs)
